title: test(pathkernel): the old-planner baseline of each phase-1 kind
body:
Side branch: side/path-kernel

## What changed

This PR records the output of the OLD planners on `side/path-kernel` for the 15 phase-1 kinds that had no baseline (#4153, part of #4023). The switch-over proof compares the new kernel with these files. The PR adds tests and golden files only. It changes no planner code and no existing golden or assert.

- Form: the #3750 form. Each golden is the CL text at 1 um, with one `; note:` line for each note. The app pin also has one `; warning:` line for each verifier warning.
- Motion level: 15 pins (14 kinds) in the new tree `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels/kernel_baseline/`. One file for each kind, with a shared `mod.rs` (`golden`, `dump`, `pin` and the fixtures). The tree joins the `pass_start_levels` directory suite with one `mod` line at the END of `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels.rs`. PR #4123 changes lines 9-11 and 23-24 of that file, so the two PRs merge in either order. No helper or golden of #4123 is copied.
- App level: the 2D Pocket on `fig8.step` in `crates/app/tests/pocket_pass_start/kernel_baseline.rs`, a submodule of the existing `pocket_pass_start` binary (one `#[path]` mod line). It uses the #3354 fixture (`fig8_world`, `pocket_op`) and `write_golden` of `common/mod.rs`. Five fig8 generations run past the 60 s debug budget, so the full pin is in the heavy lane (`app heavy: pocket_pass_start`). Its light twin records the Waterline Auto case.
- `crates/cl/tests/headless_bin.rs`: `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden` reads every `.cl` golden. It now round-trips only the CL text before the `; note:` and `; warning:` lines. This hunk is byte-identical to the hunk of PR #4123 in the same file, so git merges the two branches cleanly in either order. Without it, the new goldens fail that test. It changes no assert on the CL text.
- No new test binary. No new dependency.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/4153-old-planner-baselines.md`.

| Kind | Cases | Test | Golden files |
|---|---|---|---|
| Face | 6: climb, conventional, stepped, blended, hole, start and exit pick | `kernel_baseline::face::kernel_baseline_face` | `crates/motion/tests/golden/kernel_face_{climb,conventional,stepped,blended,hole,picked}.cl` |
| 2D Contour | 10: Outside (plunge, conventional, ramp, helix, arc lead, start pick, tabs), Inside (plunge, conventional, helix) | `kernel_baseline::contour::kernel_baseline_contour` | `kernel_contour_{outside,outside_conventional,outside_ramp,outside_helix,outside_arc_lead,outside_picked,outside_tabs,inside,inside_conventional,inside_helix}.cl` |
| 2D Pocket (app) | 5: Waterline Auto, Inside, Outside; Offset rings Outside; Zigzag | `kernel_baseline::fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline` (heavy), `..._light` (light) | `crates/app/tests/golden/kernel_pocket2d_fig8_{waterline_auto,waterline_inside,waterline_outside,rings_outside,zigzag}.cl` |
| 2D Adaptive | 4: spiral Auto, Inside, Outside; trochoidal | `kernel_baseline::adaptive::kernel_baseline_adaptive`, `..._adaptive_trochoidal` | `kernel_adaptive_{auto,inside,outside,trochoidal}.cl` |
| Engrave | 3: avoid spec climb, conventional, empty spec | `kernel_baseline::engrave::kernel_baseline_engrave` | `kernel_engrave_{avoid_climb,avoid_conventional,avoid_empty}.cl` |
| V-Carve | 5: narrow, hexagon, wide, wide with flat clear, 60 degree | `kernel_baseline::v_carve::kernel_baseline_v_carve` | `kernel_v_carve_{narrow,hexagon,wide,wide_flat_clear,narrow_60deg}.cl` |
| 2D Chamfer | 6: outside, conventional, 30 degree, inside, inside with retract, open run | `kernel_baseline::chamfer::kernel_baseline_chamfer` | `kernel_chamfer_{outside,outside_conventional,outside_30deg,inside,inside_retract,open_run}.cl` |
| Circular | 9: Auto, Inside, Outside, conventional, ramp, helix, arc, vault, vault Outside | `kernel_baseline::circular::kernel_baseline_circular` | `kernel_circular_{auto,inside,outside,conventional,ramp,helix,arc,vault,vault_outside}.cl` |
| Slot | 8: plunge, ramp, conventional; wide slot plain, conventional, helix, arc, stock to leave | `kernel_baseline::slot::kernel_baseline_slot` | `kernel_slot_{plunge,ramp,conventional,wide,wide_conventional,wide_helix,wide_arc,wide_stock_to_leave}.cl` |
| Trochoidal slot | 5: microlift, retract, conventional, stock top, 16 mm wide | `kernel_baseline::trochoid_slot::kernel_baseline_trochoid_slot` | `kernel_trochoid_slot_{straight,straight_retract,straight_conventional,straight_stock_top,wide}.cl` |
| Trace | 5: plate climb, conventional, stepped, stock top; round loop | `kernel_baseline::trace::kernel_baseline_trace` | `kernel_trace_{plate_climb,plate_conventional,plate_stepped,plate_stock_top,round}.cl` |
| Slot Undercut | 4: T-slot conventional, keyseat straight, dovetail arc, lollipop straight | `kernel_baseline::undercut::kernel_baseline_undercut` | `kernel_undercut_{tslot_conventional,keyseat_straight,dovetail_arc,lollipop_straight}.cl` |
| Thread | 7: internal right climb, conventional, left, two rows, two holes; external right climb, left conventional | `kernel_baseline::thread::kernel_baseline_thread` | `kernel_thread_{internal_right_climb,internal_right_conventional,internal_left_climb,internal_right_two_rows,internal_two_holes,external_right_climb,external_left_conventional}.cl` |
| Bore | 9: Auto, Inside, Outside, conventional, ramp, helix, arc, helix Outside, through | `kernel_baseline::bore::kernel_baseline_bore` | `kernel_bore_{auto,inside,outside,conventional,ramp,helix,arc,helix_outside,through}.cl` |
| 3D Pocket | 9: Waterline and Offset rings with Auto, Inside, Outside; Zigzag; Adaptive; Waterline helix on two levels | `kernel_baseline::pocket3d::kernel_baseline_pocket3d` | `kernel_pocket3d_{waterline_auto,waterline_inside,waterline_outside,rings_auto,rings_inside,rings_outside,zigzag,adaptive,waterline_helix_levels}.cl` |

Motion test paths are in `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels/kernel_baseline/`, motion goldens in `crates/motion/tests/golden/`.

## Goldens moved

Additions only. No existing golden changes.

- `crates/motion/tests/golden/kernel_*.cl`: 90 new files (the table above).
- `crates/app/tests/golden/kernel_pocket2d_fig8_*.cl`: 5 new files.

## Readings and tests

- Recorded with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`, then run two times without it: green both times (motion: 15 passed, about 40 s for the set in debug; app full pin and light twin: 2 passed in release, about 14 s). The output is the same in each run.
- Debug times on a host with a load of about 40: the slowest motion pins are `kernel_baseline_adaptive` (18 s), `kernel_baseline_pocket3d` (32 s) and `kernel_baseline_trochoid_slot` (19-33 s). All are under the 60 s budget.
- Quick gate on the final head `ebfcedf5e`: `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6 xvfb-run -a cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel`: 1219 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (64.8 min). It includes `motion suites: pass_start_levels` (ok), `app suites: pocket_pass_start` (ok) and `cl suites: headless_bin` (ok). The new goldens select many suites through the shared golden folders.
- The first quick gate run, without the `headless_bin` change, failed `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden` on the annotated goldens. The second commit fixes it.
- Clippy `-D warnings`: `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels`, `camcraft-cl --test headless_bin`, `camcraft-app --test pocket_pass_start`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed. `app light: pocket_pass_start` runs `fig8_pocket_kernel_baseline_light`: ok.

## Not exercised

- No verifier warnings at the motion level: no verifier runs there, as in the #3750 motion pins. Only the app pin records warnings.
- The other kinds are not recorded at the app level (the motion level records the same planner output).
- The trochoidal slot has no curved chain: the old planner refuses a polyline bend and an arc of radius 30 at a width of 12 ("the centre line turns too tightly for loops this wide").
- The trace strokes of a sketch (`TraceStrokes`) and the rest-machining variants are not in the set.
- No heavy step runs (a P2 PR).

Changelog: none

Effort: high
